versions.content: Service Name Xxx_WriteData Syntax Std_ReturnType Xxx_WriteData ( const uint8 * Data, uint16 DataLength, Dcm_OpStatusType OpStatus, Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType * ErrorCode ) Service ID [hex] 0x3e Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Data Buffer containing the data to be written DataLength Length in byte of the data to be written Parameters (in) OpStatus Status of the current operation 5 271 of 683  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 18: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticCommunicationManager Specification of Diagnostic Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) ErrorCode If the operation Xxx_WriteData returns value E_NOT_OK, the DCM module shall send a negative response with NRC code equal to the parameter ErrorCode parameter value. Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Request was successful. E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful. DCM_E_PENDING: Request is not yet finished. Further call(s) required to finish. Description This function requests the application to write a data value of a DID. Available via Dcm_Externals.h
